### CVE-2011-0420
- Assigner: certcc | Published: 2011-02-18 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 16182: PHP 5.3.5 - 'grapheme_extract()' Null Pointer Dereference (dos/linux, 2011-02-17, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 35354: PHP 5.3.5 - 'grapheme_extract()' Null Pointer Dereference Denial of Service (dos/php, 2011-02-17, verified=1)

The grapheme_extract function in the Internationalization extension (Intl) for ICU for PHP 5.3.5 allows context-dependent attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via an invalid size argument, which triggers a NULL pointer dereference.

### CVE-2011-0421
- Assigner: certcc | Published: 2011-03-20 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 17004: PHP 5.3.5 libzip 0.9.3 - _zip_name_locate Null Pointer Dereference (dos/linux, 2011-03-18, verified=0)

The _zip_name_locate function in zip_name_locate.c in the Zip extension in PHP before 5.3.6 does not properly handle a ZIPARCHIVE::FL_UNCHANGED argument, which might allow context-dependent attackers to cause a denial of service (NULL pointer dereference) via an empty ZIP archive that is processed with a (1) locateName or (2) statName operation.

### CVE-2011-1398
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2012-08-30 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 37688: PHP 5.3.11/5.4.0RC2 - 'header()' HTTP Header Injection (remote/php, 2011-10-06, verified=1)

The sapi_header_op function in main/SAPI.c in PHP before 5.3.11 and 5.4.x before 5.4.0RC2 does not check for %0D sequences (aka carriage return characters), which allows remote attackers to bypass an HTTP response-splitting protection mechanism via a crafted URL, related to improper interaction between the PHP header function and certain browsers, as demonstrated by Internet Explorer and Google Chrome.
